react_result.final_narrative_text: Three complementary pathway-enrichment paradigms converge on the same biological axes. The dominant signal is Glycine, serine and threonine metabolism (KEGG:hsa00260 / KEGG:map00260), which achieves top rank across RaMP multi-DB ORA (FDR 1.27e-19, 8 metabolites), mummichog m/z-direct activity (p = 0.00118, 14 of 14 pathway members), and MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA (p = 2.12e-08, 6 metabolites). The driver metabolites anchoring this signal are glycine (KEGG:C00037), L-threonine (KEGG:C00188), O-phospho-L-serine (KEGG:C01005), L-cystathionine (KEGG:C02291), guanidinoacetic acid (KEGG:C00581), and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine (KEGG:C00021). The second cross-paradigm winner is Methionine and cysteine metabolism (RaMP: WP:WP4292, FDR 5.67e-13; mummichog p = 0.0215; MetaboAnalystR KEGG:hsa00270 p = 1.0 but hit by L-cystathionine, S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine, L-cysteine and O-phospho-L-serine). This axis is driven by L-cysteine (KEGG:C00097), S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine (KEGG:C00021), L-cystathionine (KEGG:C02291) and sulfate (KEGG:C00059). A secondary KEGG:hsa00670 one-carbon pool by folate signal (MetaboAnalystR p = 1.0, glycine + SAH hit) and niacinamide (KEGG:C00153) in the niacinamide vitamin B3 pathway (mummichog p = 0.0428) further extend the perturbation to one-carbon folate cycles and NAD+ salvage. N1-acetylspermidine (KEGG:C00612) implicates polyamine metabolism. The treatment condition therefore coordinately disrupts one-carbon amino-acid metabolism centred on glycine-serine-threonine, with a downstream cascade into methionine/cysteine sulfur amino acid cycling, folate one-carbon pool, and NAD+ homeostasis — a pattern consistent with oxidative stress or methyl-group demand.

  "narrative_text": "Three complementary pathway-enrichment paradigms identified Glycine, serine and threonine metabolism as the primary affected pathway. RaMP multi-DB ORA returned KEGG:map00260 at rank 1 with FDR 1.27e-19 and fold enrichment 689.5, capturing 8 of 12 input metabolites. MetaboAnalystR PSEA independently confirmed the human-curated ortholog KEGG:hsa00260 at rank 2 with p-value 2.12e-08, hitting 6 metabolites. Mummichog m/z-direct activity scored the same metabolic module as top hit (p=0.00269) with 14 of 14 compounds mapping to the pathway. The four driver compounds driving this enrichment are glycine (KEGG:C00037), L-threonine (KEGG:C00188), phosphoserine (KEGG:C01005), and L-cysteine (KEGG:C00097), all verified members of hsa00260. A secondary sulfur-amino acid module centered on methionine and cysteine metabolism appeared consistently across mummichog (p=0.0207) and RaMP (WP:WP4292, FDR 5.67e-13), anchored by S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine (KEGG:C00021), L-cystathionine (KEGG:C02291), L-cysteine (KEGG:C00097), and glycine (KEGG:C00037). Nicotinamide (KEGG:C00153) independently maps to vitamin B3 metabolism (mummichog p=0.0409) and the NAD+ salvage branch of purine metabolism (MetaboAnalystR hsa00230, p=0.0811). S-adenosylhomocysteine additionally participates in the methionine cycle, consistent with methyl-group cycling demand. MetaboAnalystR PSEA independently confirmed the human-curated ortholog KEGG:hsa00260 at rank 2 with p-value 2.12e-08, hitting 6 metabolites. Mummichog m/z-direct activity scored the same metabolic module as top hit (p=0.00269) with 14 of 14 compounds mapping to the pathway. The four driver compounds driving this enrichment are glycine (KEGG:C00037), L-threonine (KEGG:C00188), phosphoserine (KEGG:C01005), and L-cysteine (KEGG:C00097), all verified members of hsa00260. A secondary sulfur-amino acid module centered on methionine and cysteine metabolism appeared consistently across mummichog (p=0.0207) and RaMP (WP:WP4292, FDR 5.67e-13), anchored by S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine (KEGG:C00021), L-cystathionine (KEGG:C02291), L-cysteine (KEGG:C00097), and glycine (KEGG:C00037).
